The builder renders /pricing/ (table, billing toggle, currency switch, calculator, Stripe links), the SoftwareApplication offers and the pricing section of llms.txt from this file. Prices are monthly list prices in USD; term discounts apply to the plan base only.

seat_types.Analyst: 50 calls per rolling 5-hour window · 150 a week
seat_types.Specialist: 120 calls per rolling 5-hour window · 400 a week

rows.name: Agentic seats
rows.detail: Every seat is one named user with full dashboard access and the agentic MCP connector — no dashboard-only seats. A seat is a pure call quota on a rolling 5-hour window plus a weekly ceiling (resets Monday 00:00 UTC, no rollover); hit a window cap mid-build and the seat pauses, then auto-resumes. Analyst: 50 calls / 5-hour window · 150 / week. Specialist: 120 / 5-hour window · 400 / week. From production logs the median complete pitch build is ≈30 calls. Seats are reassignable monthly, never shared. Additional seats can be added up to each plan's cap — 2 on Light, 4 on Pro, 5 on Agency Light, 7 on Agency Pro — at Analyst US$300 / month and Specialist US$600 / month; beyond the cap, upgrade or talk to sales.

values.note: One Analyst seat — dashboard + MCP. The seat carries its own quota: 50 calls per rolling 5-hour window · 150 a week — ≈22 complete pitch builds a month at the ≈30-call median.
One Specialist seat — dashboard + MCP. The seat carries its own quota: 120 calls per rolling 5-hour window · 400 a week — ≈58 complete pitch builds a month at the ≈30-call median.

Three Analyst seats — dashboard + MCP. Each seat carries its own quota: 50 calls per rolling 5-hour window · 150 a week — ≈22 complete pitch builds a month per seat (≈65 across the plan). Quotas are per seat, non-transferable.

Three Specialist seats — dashboard + MCP. Each seat carries its own quota: 120 calls per rolling 5-hour window · 400 a week — ≈58 complete pitch builds a month per seat (≈173 across the plan). Quotas are per seat, non-transferable.

rows.name: Brands monitored
rows.detail: Active brand handles under continuous crawl across the plan’s channel set — expandable in +10-handle blocks (US$190 / month on Light plans, US$390 / month on Pro plans) — up to 2 blocks on brand plans and 3 on agency plans; larger portfolios move up a tier or to Enterprise.

rows.name: Handle swaps / month
rows.detail: Re-points a handle to a new brand with its fresh 12-month deep crawl — re-pointing to an already-crawled brand is instant and unmetered; fair use applies.

rows.name: No overage fees
rows.detail: Quotas pause and auto-resume — nothing ever bills past your plan. Hit a window cap mid-build and the seat waits for the next window; weekly ceilings reset Monday. No metered surprises, no volume fees.

policy: Your subscription fee is billed in advance for the selected subscription period.
